name: donor-payment-source-selection
description: Use 'razorpay_payments' for questions about captured online payments, not 't_80g_receipts_2025'.

trigger.question_regex: captured payment|gave twice|donors made more than one

claim: For questions about 'captured payments' or donor payment frequency, query the 'razorpay_payments' table. Do not join with 't_80g_receipts_2025' unless specifically asked for 80G receipt details, as 'razorpay_payments' contains the transaction status and email directly.
